description: This file defines the main editing page component for a blog post within a React application. It includes functionalities such as loading existing posts, editing title and content, real-time auto-saving, publishing/unpublishing, deleting posts, and handling image uploads. The component integrates with various hooks and components for rich text editing, routing, and UI elements.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a callback function with a specified delay, used to limit how often auto-save occurs during rapid user input.

methods.name: ensurePostId
methods.description: Ensures the post has an ID by creating a new post if necessary, using the current title and content, updating the URL accordingly.

methods.name: debouncedSave
methods.description: Auto-saves the current title and content after a debounce delay to prevent excessive network requests.

methods.name: handleUploadImage
methods.description: Handles image uploading by calling an external upload utility and returning the image URL.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Updates local content state and triggers debounced auto-save when the editor content changes.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Updates local title state and triggers debounced auto-save when the title input changes.

methods.name: handleManualSave
methods.description: Allows manual saving of the post, updating title and content on the server.

methods.name: handleTogglePublish
methods.description: Toggles the publish state of the post, ensuring the slug is unique before publishing.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current post and navigates back to the dashboard after user confirmation.
